description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to fetching and handling roadmap data, including JSON structures, rendering options, and API calls for roadmap details, list, and content.

methods.name: roadmapJSONOptions
methods.description: Fetches JSON data and SVG rendering for a specific roadmap by ID.

methods.name: listBuiltInRoadmaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of built-in roadmaps filtered by group 'roadmaps'.

methods.name: roadmapDetailsOptions
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific roadmap by ID.

methods.name: roadmapContentOptions
methods.description: Fetches content data related to a specific roadmap ID.
